name: perl-devel-cycle
description: This tool traverses Perl reference trees to identify circularities and memory leaks. Use when user asks to find memory cycles in objects, detect circular references in data structures, or debug memory leaks in Perl code.
overview: The `perl-devel-cycle` skill provides tools to traverse Perl reference trees and identify circularities. Because Perl uses reference counting for memory management, any group of objects that reference each other will never have their reference counts reach zero, leading to persistent memory leaks. This skill enables the developer to find these cycles, including those hidden within code closures (if PadWalker is installed) and weakened references.
